summary: Somnigroup International Inc. filed an 8-K reporting Q2 2026 financial results and declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.17 per share, payable September 3, 2026, to shareholders of record as of August 20, 2026. The filing includes a press release covering results, EPS growth, and revised 2026 guidance. This is a routine earnings and dividend announcement, not a special situation, as no strategic transaction, activist activity, or corporate action beyond ordinary capital return is indicated.
